what: A light-cone shape (triangle clip-path) unfolds from a single vertex — down: the top two corners spread from the bottom-center vertex (light rays fanning over a magnifier lens·flame video), right: the right edge opens up and down from the left-center vertex (a sky-blue cone lit by a hand-held magnifier). The first screen opens once with .8s power1.inOut, and on scroll it opens at 1s ease-in-out when the panel center crosses the 75% line of the screen and folds back with the same curve when scrolled back up

options.dir: Vertex side — down (default, below the vertex) · up · right (left of the vertex) · left
options.on: load means once right after attaching (after delay), otherwise on scroll
options.delay: When on: load delay in seconds, default 0 — brand 1.3
options.line: Screen height % where the center of the scroll panel lands, default 75 — 95 on phones
options.back: If off, it does not fold back even when scrolled back up

from.where: index.html .mc-fv__rays · .mc-fv__fire (Hero — original: clipPath polygon(50% 0,50% 0,50% 100%) → polygon(100% 0,0 0,50% 100%) .8s power1.inOut + opacity, timeline .5 + .8s) · .mc-contact__cone (original: polygon(0 50%,100% 50%,100% 50%) → polygon(0 50%,100% 100%,100% 0), transition clip-path 1s ease-in-out, triggered when the panel center passes the 75% line of the screen (95% on phone))
